description: Answers from Host.al support (help centre): .al domains (registration, AKEP approval, transfers, EPP codes, owner changes), DNS and nameservers, web hosting (Plesk), email, SSL, VPS (VirtFusion panel, reinstall, SSH, traffic, IPs, port 25, BGP), dedicated servers (delivery, iDRAC/IPMI), colocation, billing and payments (Pago, PayPal, invoices, refunds) and account security (2FA). Returns the best matching questions with full answers and a link to each answer. Use it before telling a user to contact support.

language.description: Language of the answers: "en" English or "sq" Albanian

query.description: The user's question or keywords, e.g. "transfer .al domain", "change nameservers", "VPS root password", "fiscal invoice"
